data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for implementing in-app purchases and subscriptions.
data.what_it_does: A comprehensive plugin for handling in-app purchases across mobile platforms. It implements the OpenIAP Client Protocol to provide standard purchase flows and product fetching.
use_when: You need to sell digital goods, in-app products, or subscriptions in your Flutter app.
You want cross-platform IAP consistency using the OpenIAP protocol.
avoid_when: You prefer using the official Flutter `in_app_purchase` package without third-party protocol wrappers.
Your app does not require any monetization or billing features.
strengths: Conforms to the OpenIAP Client Protocol for shared purchase behaviors.
Supports multiple stores (Google Play, Apple App Store, Amazon, Horizon).
Active maintenance and clear developer documentation.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and native dependency resolution for Apple and Android targets.
Android store SDK behavior depends on gradle property configurations.
data.setup_notes: Requires native Apple platform targets of iOS 15.0+ or macOS 14.0+. On older Flutter versions or when SPM is disabled, run pod install in the ios/macos directories.
